newsitem.title: UK: Schroders slides after cautious outlook.
newsitem.headline: Schroders slides after cautious outlook.

text.p: Shares in Schroders Plc dropped sharply on Friday after the investment bank released first half pretax profit figures and a cautious outlook.
Schroders shares, around five pence lower before the figures, dropped to a day's low of 1,390p and traded at 1,397-1/2p at 1001 GMT, down 50p on the day.

The shares had gained early in the week on vague bid speculation and hopes for the first-half results. "We weren't too happy about the forecasts. Talk about uncertain business conditions is not what investors want to hear," a London marketmaker said.

Schroders said first-half pretax profits rose 35.4 percent to 115.9 million stg, in line with market expectations, but cautioned that conditions for its businesses may become more uncertain with elections imminent here and in the U.S.
It said the second half started well but that it would not be easy to match two successive record half years.

"Basically, the figures are bang in line with consensus forecasts but the dividend is much better. People had expected five pence or 5.5p," said one analyst at a leading London brokerage. Schroders paid a six pence interim dividend.

The analyst said he was encouraged by healthy growth in merchant and investment banking profits but warned the cautious outlook could lead to some earnings downgrades on the stock, which stabilised at 1045 GMT around 1,390p.
